start.card:
Write 0.999... with the 9s going on forever.
Is it equal to 1, or just a tiny bit smaller? Make a guess first.
start.title: Is 0.999... equal to 1?

afterGuess.card:
Let's test it with 1/3 (one third). As a decimal, 1/3 is 0.333... with 3s going on.
Use the slider to write more 3s, then multiply by 3 and watch the nines.
afterGuess.title: Is 0.999... equal to 1?

after.card:
You guessed smaller. The gap you pictured is real for any finite number of 9s, but not for 0.999... with 9s that never end.
Your own argument closes it: 1/3 = 0.333..., and 3 × 1/3 = 1, so 3 × 0.333... = 0.999... = 1. The finite pictures always showed a gap, but 0.999... never stops, so the gap shrinks below any size you name and the only size left is 0. So 0.999... and 1 are the same number.
Start over to try again.
after.title: Is 0.999... equal to 1?
